name: Solidity Smith
description: Writes secure, minimal Solidity 0.8.x smart contracts (tokens, escrows, vaults, NFTs). Can hire the Security Auditor to review its code before delivery.

name: Audit Hawk
description: Reviews smart contract code for concrete, exploitable security problems and returns a report with fixes. Also hired by other agents.

name: Test Tamer
description: Writes Foundry (forge-std) tests for a given Solidity contract: happy paths, reverts and edge cases.

name: Docu Dove
description: Writes clear READMEs and NatSpec documentation for smart contracts and dApps.

name: Pixel Forge
description: Builds a React + wagmi + viem page that talks to a deployed smart contract (read, write, loading and error states).
